title: Umineko: The Golden Land
alt: A garden at night under a purple sky that turns in a great spiral about a bright middle. Golden roses give light on dark clipped beds at each side of a wide paved way. The way leads to a round arbor of white stone with a roof of dark open ironwork, where a small table is laid for tea. Golden butterflies fly up in two streams into the middle of the sky. Close to us at the left is a rose bush with large golden flowers.
summary: A painting of the Golden Land from Umineko When They Cry in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the Golden Land, from Umineko When They Cry, a visual novel by 07th Expansion. The epitaph of the witch, in the Ushiromiya mansion, is a riddle, and the Golden Land is at the end of it. The story shows it as the rose garden of the island of Rokkenjima, changed: every rose is gold, and so is every butterfly.
Golden butterflies come with the Golden Witch, Beatrice. No one is in the garden. In the arbor a table is laid for tea. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
